listing.name: Golden Sun Recompiled (GSRecomp)
listing.summary: Prepare either Golden Sun game from your own matching ROM through the shared upstream launcher.

steps.title: Prepare either game with the shared launcher
steps.instruction: Extract the whole official package. Choose GoldenSunLauncher.exe on Windows, or GoldenSunLauncher on Linux, then choose The Broken Seal or The Lost Age and your own matching USA/Europe GBA ROM. Keep the normal SHA-1 ROM check enabled. No GBA BIOS is required. The bundled compiler prepares game code on first launch and after updates; Linux also needs system SDL2 and OpenGL. Portcove does not run this builder during discovery.

steps.title: Register the collection launcher
steps.instruction: Choose the shared launcher and its folder as the working directory in Portcove. Save launch details, then choose Play separately. Keep the complete collection together, including the per-game builders and generated output. This remains one collection identity for both games. Upstream reports public-testing bugs; successful preparation is not completed gameplay qualification.

steps.title: Keep current data and rebuild after updates
steps.instruction: You or upstream own this external player. The launcher offers a newer release download; it does not make this a managed Portcove Update. Close both games and retain your working folder before updating. Back up ROMs, Saves (including Saves/Imported), Controls, Music mods, and the per-game settings under games, plus any custom paths. External save imports leave their originals in place and preserve conflicts under Saves/Imported. Legacy progress already inside this collection’s ROMs folder can move into Saves after verified copy or conflict preservation. A new version can rebuild game code from your ROM. Runtime replacement does not rewind saves or guarantee savestate compatibility. Keep original-containing data private. External registration preserves every file and supplies no managed Backup or Rollback.
